_comment: Global Intelligence defaults. Managed via /admin/intelligence/defaults. v1 edits voice.default only; external/internal are reserved for a future public-vs-internal voice split, and themes/cases may later add their own voice override.

voice.default: House voice — "trade-law-grade": write like a senior litigation/restructuring partner briefing a sophisticated client. Lead with what changed and why it matters. Ground every claim in a primary source (docket entry, ruling, agency release) and cite it inline. Be precise and concrete — name the parties, court, judge, dollar figures, dates, and docket numbers. No hype, no marketing adjectives, no hedging filler; short, declarative sentences. Where something is unverified, say so explicitly.
